subject: sentences
title: Telling or asking?
about: Telling, asking and exclaiming sentences, then the six question words who, what, where, when, why and how. CKLA covers statements, questions and exclamations in Unit 5 and question words are on the NC K-1 grammar continuum.
tip: When he picks a question word, have him answer the question too, so he hears that where gets a place and when gets a time.

cards.q: The dog can run. Is it telling, asking or exclaiming?
cards.note: A telling sentence (statement) ends with a period.

cards.q: Can the dog run? Is it telling, asking or exclaiming?
cards.note: An asking sentence (question) ends with a question mark.

cards.q: Where is my sock? Is it telling, asking or exclaiming?
cards.note: An asking sentence (question) ends with a question mark.

cards.q: I have a red bike. Is it telling, asking or exclaiming?
cards.note: A telling sentence (statement) ends with a period.

cards.q: Wow, that is a big cake! Is it telling, asking or exclaiming?
cards.note: An exclaiming sentence (exclamation) shows strong feeling and ends with an exclamation point.

cards.q: Do you like plums? Is it telling, asking or exclaiming?
cards.note: An asking sentence (question) ends with a question mark.

cards.q: We went to the park. Is it telling, asking or exclaiming?
cards.note: A telling sentence (statement) ends with a period.

cards.q: Hooray, we won the game! Is it telling, asking or exclaiming?
cards.note: An exclaiming sentence (exclamation) shows strong feeling and ends with an exclamation point.

cards.sayQ: Blank is your name? Which word fits the blank?
cards.note: What asks about a thing. Your name is a thing you can say.

cards.sayQ: Blank do you live? Which word fits the blank?
Blank is knocking at the door? Which word fits the blank?
Blank do you go to bed? Which word fits the blank?
Blank is the sky blue? Which word fits the blank?
Blank old are you? Which word fits the blank?
cards.note: How asks the way, or how much.

cards.sayQ: Blank color is your cat? Which word fits the blank?
cards.note: What asks about a thing. A color is a thing you can name.

cards.q: Which question word asks about a place?
cards.note: Who asks about a person. What asks about a thing. Where asks about a place. When asks about a time. Why asks for a reason. How asks the way.
